title: Pocketwire Visa Debit Card Rate Card: Gift Card Lift in Pocketwire Rewards
content:
Pocketwire Rewards values points for a gift card at a higher rate for members whose active physical Pocketwire Visa Debit Card is on one of the top card tiers.

## Rule

The gift card card-tier lift is 0.10 cents per point when the member's active physical debit card is a Pocketwire Visa Infinite Metal Debit card, 0.05 cents per point when it is a Pocketwire Visa Infinite Debit or Pocketwire Visa Signature Debit card, and nothing when it is any other card or there is none.

The lift is added to the gift card rate per point before the rate is applied to the points redeemed. The record read is the member's Pocketwire Visa Debit Card whose status is active and whose form is physical, and the card tier it carries.

## Lift by card tier

| Active physical card | Lift (cents per point) |
|---|---|
| Pocketwire Visa Infinite Metal Debit | 0.10 |
| Pocketwire Visa Infinite Debit | 0.05 |
| Pocketwire Visa Signature Debit | 0.05 |
| any other card tier | nothing |
| no active physical card | nothing |

## Points of judgement

- A Pocketwire Visa Signature Debit card that is blocked is not active and does not give the lift.
- Only the physical card decides the lift; a virtual card on the same account does not.
